Heat potato with Microwave. Wash a plate:
def Heat_potato_with_Microwave_Wash_a_plate_three_times_and_cook_fried_egg():
	# 0: Heat potato with Microwave
	walk('Potato')
	pickup('Potato')
	walk('Microwave')
	assert('close' to 'Microwave')
		else: walk('Microwave')
	assert('Microwave' is 'open')
		else: open('Microwave')
	put('Potato', 'Microwave')
	close('Microwave')
	toggleon('Microwave')
	assert('Potato' is 'cooked')
	toggleoff('Microwave')
	open('Microwave')
	pickup('Potato')
	close('Microwave')
	walk('CounterTop')
	put('Potato', 'CounterTop')

	# 1: Wash a plate three times
	walk('Plate')
	pickup('Plate')
	walk('Faucet')
	toggleon('Faucet')
	put('Plate', 'SinkBasin')
	toggleoff('Faucet')
	pickup('Plate')

	toggleon('Faucet')
	put('Plate', 'SinkBasin')
	toggleoff('Faucet')
	pickup('Plate')

	toggleon('Faucet')
	put('Plate', 'SinkBasin')
	toggleoff('Faucet')
	pickup('Plate')

	walk('CounterTop')
	put('Plate', 'CounterTop')

	# 2: Cook fried egg
	assert('Pan' on 'StoveBurner')
		else: walk('Pan')
		else: pickup('Pan')
		else: walk('StoveBurner')
		else: put('Pan', 'StoveBurner')

	walk('StoveKnob')
	toggleon('StoveKnob')

	walk('Egg')
	pickup('Egg')
	walk('Pan')
	assert('Egg' in 'hand')
		else: walk('Egg')
		else: pickup('Egg')
		else: walk('Pan')

	assert('close' to 'Pan')
		else: walk('Pan')

	put('Egg', 'Pan')
	slice('Egg')

	walk('StoveKnob')
	toggleoff('StoveKnob')
